daily.today_energy: Mercury in your sign is giving you clarity and sharp communication skills today. With Mars conjunct Jupiter firing up, there's major expansive energy in the air—just watch that you don't overpromise. Stay grounded.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is blessing your connections with warmth and generosity. If you're coupled, this is a great day to show up differently. Single? Your natural magnetism is turned way up right now.
daily.career: The Mars-Jupiter conjunction is pushing you toward bold moves, but Saturn retrograde is asking you to double-check your strategy first. Trust your Scorpio instincts—your gut knows what's solid and what's just hype.
daily.health: Moon in Taurus wants you to slow down and actually rest today. That Sun-Mars square might make you feel restless, but pushing harder isn't the move. Take it easy, hydrate, and listen to what your body needs.

weekly.overview: Mercury in your sign keeps your mind sharp and cutting through BS—use it. Mars conjuncts Jupiter midweek, amplifying your power moves, but watch the Sun square Mars clash later (potential ego friction). Best Day: Wednesday. Watch-Out Day: Friday. Moon swings from grounded Taurus into curious Gemini, then into bold Leo territory, pushing you toward action and visibility.
weekly.love: Early week feels intimate and real with Mercury helping you speak your truth. Midweek's Mars-Jupiter conjunction electrifies attraction—your magnetism is off the charts. By Friday, the Sun-Mars square might spark unnecessary drama, so check your pride at the door. If single, you're magnetic. If coupled, communicate before tension builds.
weekly.career: This week is about making moves. Mercury in Scorpio gives you tactical thinking; use it for strategy and negotiations. Wednesday's Mars-Jupiter peak is prime time for pitches, launches, or bold asks—momentum is real. The Sun-Mars square Friday could bring unexpected obstacles or competitive energy. Roll with it; you're resourceful enough to navigate.
weekly.health: Your energy spikes midweek thanks to Mars-Jupiter, but don't burn out. The Moon's shift into Leo amplifies your need for visibility and intensity—channel it into workouts or activities that make you feel powerful. By weekend, rest intentionally. Mars moving into Virgo later in the week favors precision over chaos.
